recommendation: Keep the source fix. It aligns FHIR-36039's old subset guidance with later R6 RelatedArtifact simplification without reintroducing a superseded global subset/invariant; any new machine-checkable subset rule should be a new methodology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-36039 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested multiple RelatedArtifactType code/definition changes, a subset of codes for RelatedArtifact references to FHIR resources, an invariant enforcing that subset, and guidance that RelatedArtifact should be used only with definitional resources.
initial_application: Commit bb9b33616984aecc330c7a9ac8d252854387aae4 applied the tracker by expanding the RelatedArtifactType source list, adding source/datatypes/valueset-fhir-related-artifact-type.xml, and adding a RelatedArtifact.type comment that mandated the fhir-related-artifact-type subset for FHIR-resource references.
additional_context: FHIR-50010 later simplified RelatedArtifact in R6, reducing RelatedArtifact.type to nine codes and adding resource/profile usage guidance. FHIR-49758, FHIR-49759, FHIR-52968, and UP-644 moved the broader relationship-code family into resource-specific relatesTo elements bound to THO artifact-relationship-type. The current build still rendered the old fhir-related-artifact-type comment while valueset-fhir-related-artifact-type returned 404.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/relatedartifact.xml to remove the stale fhir-related-artifact-type ValueSet mandate while preserving the SHALL NOT guidance against bidirectional FHIR resource links and directing readers to RelatedArtifact usage guidance for relationship and target constraints.
source_changes: source/datatypes/relatedartifact.xml: removed the stale fhir-related-artifact-type ValueSet requirement from the RelatedArtifact.type comment and replaced it with a pointer to RelatedArtifact usage guidance.
